title: Explain the complementary roles of SNOMED CT, ICD-11 and LOINC
requirements:
- State that the core terminology standards are complementary, each covering a distinct domain, not interchangeable alternatives
- State accurately which terminologies the IPS binds and permits (SNOMED CT, ICD-11 for diagnoses)
- Add an example (e.g. laboratory order/result) where LOINC is primary, not only a mapping target
- Add LOINC panels and answer lists as an example alongside SNOMED CT
- Avoid implying that the named standards are the only or optimal choices
- Describe IPS as a minimum for particular exchange use cases, not all exchanges
- Note the history of SNOMED International/WHO mapping collaboration
- Require preservation of original codes and context alongside translation for the receiving clinician
